lines.en: label day36:
scene threesix1
School is over for the day and, in place of my typical counseling hours, I have been summoned to the staff room to...
lines.zh: 今天的课结束了，而我没去做惯常的心理咨询，反倒被叫到了教职工办公室……

lines.en: I don't know, actually.
lines.zh: 其实要干什么，我也不知道。

lines.en: I was definitely asked to do {i}something,{/i} but...I didn't really understand what was being asked. So I'm kind of just hoping it's nothing important and that no one notices.
lines.zh: 我确实被要求做{i}某件事{/i}，但……我没太听懂到底要我做什么。所以我现在基本就是在赌这不是什么要紧事，也没人会注意到。

lines.en: That's pretty much no different from what I always do, though.
lines.zh: 不过这跟我平时干的事也没什么两样。

lines.en: I've been here for a little over a month and I still haven’t gotten the hang of the more...clerical side of things.
lines.zh: 我来这里一个多月了，还是没摸清那些……偏事务性的门道。

lines.en: And it's not like I can ask for help either when this is something everyone just assumes I know already.
lines.zh: 而且这种事人人都默认我早就懂了，我也开不了口求助。

lines.en: But hey, at least my students seem to like me. And I'm a lot more interested in appealing to them than anyone my age.
lines.zh: 不过嘛，至少我的学生们似乎挺喜欢我。比起讨好同龄人，我对讨好她们可有兴趣多了。

lines.en: Disgusting, yes. I know.
lines.zh: 很恶心，对吧。我知道。

lines.en: : Sensei! We need help!
lines.zh: : 老师！我们需要帮助！

lines.en: scene threesix2
Miku and Sana suddenly appear before me. How they knew I was here? I have no idea.
lines.zh: Miku 和 Sana 突然出现在我面前。她们是怎么知道我在这儿的？我毫无头绪。

lines.en: : Okay...And what do you need help with? I'm not counseling today.
lines.zh: : 好……那你们需要什么帮助？我今天不做咨询。

lines.en: : I am very bad at cleaning!
lines.zh: : 我打扫卫生特别不行！

lines.en: : I'm going to need a little more than that, Miku.
lines.zh: : 你得说得更具体点，Miku。

lines.en: : Fine, jeez!
lines.zh: : 行吧，真是的！

lines.en: : Sana and I are on cleaning duty today, but neither of us have any idea where any of the cleaning stuff is!
lines.zh: : 今天轮到我和 Sana 值日，可我们俩完全不知道打扫用具放在哪儿！

lines.en: : Or...at least I think Sana doesn't have any idea.
lines.zh: : 或者……至少我觉得 Sana 是不知道。

lines.en: : Honestly, I haven't been able to hear anything she's said since she's so quiet and stuff and I feel weird about askin' her to talk louder.
lines.zh: : 老实说，她说话太轻了，我基本听不清她在说什么，而且我又不好意思叫她大声点。

lines.en: : Well, you certainly don't feel weird about admitting that to me right in front of her.
lines.zh: : 嗯，可你就好意思当着她的面把这话直接跟我说出来。

lines.en: : My brain doesn't work the way most brains do, okay?!
lines.zh: : 我的脑回路跟一般人不一样，行了吧？！

lines.en: : I...really don’t know where anything is either...
lines.zh: : 我……也真的什么都不知道……

lines.en: : And...umm...I'll try to talk a little...louder...
lines.zh: : 还有……嗯……我会试着……说大声一点的……

lines.en: : Okay, so we've identified the problem. But what exactly do you want me to do about it?
lines.zh: : 好，问题找到了。但你们具体想让我做什么？

lines.en: : Anything! Just help!
lines.zh: : 什么都行！帮帮我们！

lines.en: : I don't know where any of that stuff is either, though.
lines.zh: : 可我也不知道那些东西在哪儿啊。

lines.en: In fact, I barely know where anything in this[school] is and I’ve been here for over a month now.
lines.zh: 事实上，我对这所[school]里的东西几乎一无所知，而我都已经在这里待了一个多月了。

lines.en: scene threesix3
: What?! So we're doomed?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！那我们完蛋了？！

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess so.
lines.zh: : 是啊，大概是吧。

lines.en: scene threesix4
: AHHHH!! I’M NEVER GONNA MAKE IT TO SOCCER PRACTICE AT THIS RATE!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！！照这样下去我永远赶不上足球训练了！

lines.en: : I...ummm...tried telling you earlier but...I can try to do it on my own if...it will help you show up on time...
lines.zh: : 我……嗯……刚才就想跟你说的，可是……如果……能让你准时到场的话，我可以试着自己做……

lines.en: : I just...have to find everything first...
lines.zh: : 我只是……得先把东西都找齐……

lines.en: scene threesix6
: Ugh...thanks, Sana. But I ain't gonna make you do somethin' like that. I'd rather just miss practice at that rate.
lines.zh: : 唉……谢了，Sana。但我可不会让你去做那种事。那样的话我宁可旷训。

lines.en: : Besides, Makoto says I’ve gotta start learnin’ responsibility and stuff and that cleanin' is a big part of that.
lines.zh: : 再说了，Makoto 说我得开始学着负责任什么的，而打扫卫生就是其中很重要的一部分。

lines.en: : I just didn't expect it to be so much of a puzzle.
lines.zh: : 我只是没想到会像解谜游戏一样。

lines.en: To be fair, it's not really {i}supposed{/i} to be...
lines.zh: 说句公道话，这本来也不{i}该{/i}是……

lines.en: scene threesix7
: I've just gotta face it, I guess...There’s no hope for me in this world...
lines.zh: : 我想我只能面对现实了……这世上已经没有我的容身之处了……

lines.en: : I’m going to have to join the space war...
lines.zh: : 我得去参加太空战争了……

lines.en: : No one’s joining the space war, Miku. Everything will be okay.
lines.zh: : 没人要去参加太空战争，Miku。一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: : Why don’t you and Sana just...go look for an actual teacher or something?
lines.zh: : 你和 Sana 干脆……去找个真正的老师什么的？

lines.en: scene threesix8
: Actual teacher?...
lines.zh: : 真正的老师？……

lines.en: : Are you not...a real teacher, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 老师你……不是真正的老师吗？……

lines.en: Correct, Sana. I'm just some guy who was reincarnated into the body of a teacher and is now using that as a tool to get {i}closer{/i} to you and everyone else.
lines.zh: 没错，Sana。我只是个转生进了老师身体里的人，现在正把这副身体当成{i}接近{/i}你和其他所有人的工具。

lines.en: : I just meant...find someone who actually knows where stuff is.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……去找个真正知道东西放在哪儿的人。

lines.en: : What about the teacher in the class next to ours? Miss...Watabe or something?
lines.zh: : 我们隔壁班那个老师怎么样？那个……Watabe 还是什么来着的？

lines.en: : That’s a name I'm pretty sure I’ve heard mentioned before. She might know where stuff is.
lines.zh: : 我确实记得听过这个名字。她也许知道东西在哪儿。

lines.en: scene threesix9
: No way, Sensei...That teacher gives me the creeps.
lines.zh: : 别啊，老师……那个老师让我起鸡皮疙瘩。

lines.en: : And her room always smells like...candles or something.
lines.zh: : 而且她房间里总是有一股……蜡烛之类的味道。

lines.en: : You know, I'm really starting to think we should just let Sana field this on her own.
lines.zh: : 说真的，我开始觉得干脆让 Sana 一个人搞定这事就行了。

lines.en: scene threesix10
: That's fine...I can just text my mom and tell her I'll be late for work...
lines.zh: : 没关系的……我可以给我妈发短信，告诉她我上班会晚点到……

lines.en: Is it really okay to be scheduling cleaning duty for people who almost always have something to do after school?
lines.zh: 给那些放学后几乎总有事要做的人安排值日，真的合适吗？

lines.en: : Okay, whatever. I'll come look for a janitor's closet with you two. But only because I really don't remember what I was supposed to be doing in here.
lines.zh: : 好吧，随便了。我陪你们俩去找清洁工具间。不过只是因为我实在想不起来我在这儿本来要干什么。

lines.en: scene threesix11
: Heck yeah! That’s the Sensei I know and love! I knew you’d come in clutch for your old pal, Miku!
lines.zh: : 太棒了！这才是我认识并喜爱的老师！我就知道你会在关键时刻拉你老朋友 Miku 一把！

lines.en: : Just...don't expect me to do any actual cleaning once we track the supplies down. I draw the line there.
lines.zh: : 只是……等找到工具之后别指望我真去打扫。那条线我就划在这儿。

lines.en: : Deal! Now, let's hurry the heck up and get this show on the road before the rest of the team tracks me down and breaks my kneecaps for bein' late!
lines.zh: : 成交！那咱们赶紧的，趁队友还没找过来因为迟到打断我的膝盖骨，把这事儿搞定！

lines.en: scene black
scene newcleaning1
: Thanks again, Sensei! As a special reward, I’ll let you sit front row at our next soccer game!
lines.zh: : 再次感谢，老师！作为特别奖励，我允许你下次比赛坐前排！

lines.en: : I was unaware that I wasn’t already allowed to do that.
lines.zh: : 我还不知道原来我是不被允许坐前排的。

lines.en: : And...umm...I'll save you a...front row seat at the bar...
lines.zh: : 还有……嗯……我会在吧台给你留一个……前排的座位……

lines.en: : You have one row of seats.
lines.zh: : 你那儿就一排座位吧。

lines.en: scene newcleaning2
: Oh, come on Sana! You can do better than that! Give the man somethin' he really wants!
lines.zh: : 哎呀，Sana，加把劲啊！你能做得更好！给人家点真正想要的东西！

lines.en: : But...I don't really know what...Sensei would want...
lines.zh: : 可是……我不知道……老师会想要什么……

lines.en: Good.
lines.zh: 很好。

lines.en: : At least try usin' your outside voice if you're not gonna be forkin' over a decent reward! School's over! We don't gotta be quiet anymore! We're free!
lines.zh: : 既然不肯拿出像样的奖励，那至少试试用你的「室外音量」说话吧！放学了！我们不用再小声说话了！我们自由了！

lines.en: : I...don't think I have an...outside voice...
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得自己有……「室外音量」……

lines.en: : That's not true. I heard your outside voice loud and clear during your little act with Ayane during gym a while ago.
lines.zh: : 这话不对。前阵子体育课上你和 Ayane 演那出戏的时候，你的「室外音量」我听得清清楚楚。

lines.en: scene newcleaning3
: That...was for a mission...
lines.zh: : 那……是为了任务……

lines.en: : It was a...special exception...
lines.zh: : 那是……特例……

lines.en: : You went on a mission and didn’t even call your lifelong friend, Miku?!
lines.zh: : 你去执行任务居然都没叫上你一辈子的好朋友 Miku？！

lines.en: : Am I not good enough for you anymore?! Is that how things are gonna be, Sana?!
lines.zh: : 我已经不够格了吗？！Sana，事情已经变成这样了吗？！

lines.en: : Lifelong? You two have known each other that long?
lines.zh: : 一辈子？你们认识那么久了？

lines.en: scene newcleaning4
: You know it! Sana and I go all the way back to first grade! And, if you combine both of us, we've probably grown a whole foot since then!
lines.zh: : 那当然！我和 Sana 从一年级就认识了！而且，要是把我俩加起来，这些年来我们大概长高了整整一英尺！

lines.en: : That is...really not that much.
lines.zh: : 那……真的不多啊。

lines.en: : Well, we can't all be ten foot tall monsters like you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，我们又不能都像老师你这种十英尺高的怪物。

lines.en: : Sana and I were actually the two shortest girls throughout our entire school careers before high school came and Maya took my spot as the #2.
lines.zh: : 在高中之前，我和 Sana 一直都是全校最矮的两个女生，后来 Maya 来了，抢走了我的第二名。

lines.en: : Is she really shorter than you?
lines.zh: : 她真的比你矮？

lines.en: : Yeah, but she acts tall so nobody ever notices.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但她装得很高，所以没人发现。

lines.en: : But apart from her, nothing else has really changed! We're still the same girls we've always been!
lines.zh: : 除了她以外，别的都没怎么变！我们还是从前的我们！

lines.en: : I...don't know if I'd...really say that we were friends, though...
lines.zh: : 不过……我不知道我们能不能……真的算朋友……

lines.en: : We...only talked a couple times...
lines.zh: : 我们……只说过几次话……

lines.en: scene newcleaning5
: Yeah, but that’s just cause we hung out with different people! I was always with my soccer team back then and you were...
lines.zh: : 是啦，但那只是因为我们跟不同的人混！那时候我总跟足球队的人在一起，而你……

lines.en: : You were...uhh...
: Huh. Who {i}did{/i} you hang out with back then, Sana? I remember there bein' somebody, but I can't put my finger on-
lines.zh: : 咦。Sana，你那时候跟{i}谁{/i}混来着？我记得是有个人的，但我一时想不起——

lines.en: scene newcleaning6
: Oh...umm...look...
: Could...{i}that{/i} be the...janitor's closet?...
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}会不会是……清洁工具间？……

lines.en: : What?! Was it seriously right there this whole time! But we walked past that like four times on our own!
lines.zh: : 什么？！它一直就在那儿吗！可我们自己都从那儿路过四次了！

lines.en: The three of us come to a stop at the end of the hallway in front of a room that is {i}clearly{/i} labeled as the custodial closet-
lines.zh: 我们三个在走廊尽头停了下来，面前那间屋子{i}清清楚楚地{/i}标着「清洁工具间」——

lines.en: But the even more convenient part is that it's already cracked open so I don't have to break the news of not having a key to them.
lines.zh: 但更省事的是门本来就开着条缝，这样我就不用向她们坦白我没有钥匙了。

lines.en: : Come on, Sana! You can tell me more about your friends back then while we're cleanin' the chalkboard.
lines.zh: : 走吧，Sana！我们擦黑板的时候，你可以再跟我讲讲你那时候的朋友。

lines.en: : Can we...maybe talk about...umm...anything else?...
lines.zh: : 我们……能不能……聊聊别的？……

lines.en: scene newcleaning7
: Sensei! Thanks again for your help today!
lines.zh: : 老师！今天再次谢谢你的帮忙！

lines.en: : I know you mentioned not wantin' to actually help with the cleanin' part, but if you change your mind-
lines.zh: : 我知道你说过不想真的动手打扫，但如果你改变主意——

lines.en: : Nope. I’m good. Thanks, though.
lines.zh: : 不。我不用了。不过谢谢。

lines.en: : You sure? Might give ya a good chance to write dirty words on the board since we're just gonna erase the whole thing anyway.
lines.zh: : 你确定？反正最后整块黑板都要擦掉，这可是你在黑板上写脏话的大好机会。

lines.en: : Still good. Not cleaning. But thanks.
lines.zh: : 还是算了。不打扫。不过谢谢。

lines.en: : Well, hey! You know where we'll be if ya want some more of us! And you know where I'll be afterward if ya want some more of {i}me!{/i}
lines.zh: : 嘿，那又怎样！想再找我们，你知道我们在哪儿；事后想再找我，你也知道{i}我{/i}在哪儿！

lines.en: : Carefree suggestions like that are going to get you in trouble one day, Miku.
lines.zh: : 你这种没心没肺的提议，总有一天会让你惹上麻烦的，Miku。

lines.en: : Probably! But Makoto makes me carry pepper spray around, so I'll be okay.
lines.zh: : 大概吧！不过 Makoto 让我随身带着辣椒喷雾，所以没事的。

lines.en: : Th...Thank you...Sensei...
lines.zh: : 谢……谢谢你……老师……

lines.en: : You can...umm...come visit me again if...
lines.zh: : 你可以……嗯……再来看我，如果……

lines.en: : Uhh...
: You...want alcohol...
lines.zh: : 你……想要酒……

lines.en: : Thank you, Sana. That's very considerate of you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sana。你想得真周到。

lines.en: scene black
The two of them disappear into the closet and I can instantly hear a mountain of supplies toppling to the ground as one of them manages to destroy the room in record time.
lines.zh: 她们俩钻进了工具间，我立刻就听见一大堆用具哗啦啦倒地的声音——其中一个以创纪录的速度把房间给毁了。

lines.en: I doubt I'd be wrong in assuming it's Miku.
lines.zh: 我觉得猜是 Miku 应该不会错。

lines.en: Either way, not wanting to get involved any further, I return to the office and...
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我不想再掺和下去，于是回到办公室，然后……

lines.en: Try to remember whatever it is I'm supposed to be doing in there.
lines.zh: 努力回忆我到底该在这儿干什么来着。

lines.en: $ day36 = True
$ miku_love += 1
$ sana_love += 1
{i}Miku's affection has increased to [miku_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Miku 的好感度提升到了 [miku_love]！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Sana's affection has increased to [sana_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]！{/i}
